name: Donann
text: Donann is a variant spelling of Tuatha Dé Danann. MacKillop records the form as one of the orthographic variants that surface in secondary literature. The head functions as a cross-reference. Readers seeking the full material should consult the PCE node for Tuatha Dé Danann. That node carries the full MacKillop dossier for the people of the goddess Danu.

key_results: MacKillop treats it as a form of Tuatha Dé Danann.
